codes.title: Acute pyelonephritis
evidence_quotes: R flank pain, CVA tenderness marked.
codes.reasoning: The patient progressed from lower UTI symptoms to upper urinary tract infection evidenced by right flank pain, marked CVA tenderness, rigors, and high fever. Per GDL-007, the presence of flank pain, costovertebral angle tenderness, and systemic features mandates coding acute pyelonephritis as the end-state diagnosis.
